Desc:
Bettadamalali Estate | 100% Shade Grown, High Altitude Arabica 
 Experience the exquisite taste of one-hundred percent shade-grown coffee, cultivated under a harmonious blend of both planted and native trees. The unique combination of shade and high altitude nurtures the coffee beans, resulting in a slower maturation process compared to beans grown in lower altitudes. This deliberate pace of growth yields a harmoniously balanced and flavourful cup of coffee that truly stands out 
 Nestled in the breathtaking hills and valleys of the Sahyadri range, also known as the Western Ghats, the coffee estate benefits from the richness of volcanic soil, pure water sources, invigoratingly crisp air, and meticulous care from the land's stewards. These factors converge to create coffee beans of unparalleled quality, setting Bettadamalali coffee apart as a beacon of excellence 
 The commitment to quality extends to the hand-picking of each individual coffee cherry at the estate. This hands-on approach ensures that only perfectly ripe, crimson-red cherries are selected, guaranteeing a pure and untainted coffee experience. By avoiding the inclusion of underripe or green cherries, this craft cup of coffee is free from any unwanted off-flavours that can result from using unripe beans 
 Bettadamalali coffee beans undergo a meticulous washing process. The cherries are first pulped, separating the pulp from the beans. Natural fermentation follows, after which the beans are meticulously washed with pristine water. The final step involves sun-drying the beans in Bettadamalali's dedicated drying yards 
 Experience the culmination of nature's perfection and human dedication in every sip of Bettadamalali coffee. Indulge in the richness of flavour that only truly exceptional coffee can deliver 
 
 Grade: Screen 16+  
 Varietal: 100% Arabica,  SLN. 795 
 Tasting Notes: Jaggery, Dark Chocolate, Honey, Citrus Finish  
 Body: Medium - Heavy 
 Altitude: 1100-1350M 
 Processing: Washed 
 Location:    Western Ghats,  Chikmagalur

Name: Ground Coffee - Decaf - Boothangudi Estate Decaffeinated - Pack of 250g
Tasting_Notes: Jaggery, Dark Chocolate, Honey, Citrus Finish | Body: Medium - Heavy
Desc:
Boothangudi Estate | Decaffeinated Coffee | High Altitude Arabica  
  An Experimental Coffee Producer in Chikmagalur, India. This estate is Classified as a "Sacred Grove" that has a special religious and cultural importance. 
 Boothangudi Estate is located at an altitude of 1000-1000 MASL and has a  Perennial water source in the estate feeding the plantation, and as drinking water for the farmers.   
   Boothangudi is named after Lord Boothappan.   A powerful deity in the estate who is meant to protect the estate from natural calamities and keeps the people safe.   Lord Boothappan also ensures timely rains, brings birds, animals and insects to play various roles in balanced flora and fauna.    "Boothan" meaning Lord boothappan & "Gudi" meaning Temple.    Boothangudi is classified as "Sacred Groves" in india dating backing to over 2000 years old.   Every year, people from as far as 900+ kms travel to this place and offer gifts to god and pray for safety and prosperity.  
  This experimental plantation also processes it's high altitude arabicas with a  Honey process which is the most labor intensive, but worth an experiment! The natural stream, perennial water source is very essential for the estate apart from timely rains. It is used for pulping, washing and irrigation purposes. The coffee also undergoes hand garbling to remove twigs, leaves and unripe fruits before the pulping process. Just another highlight of the estate is the Areca Palms providing shades to these juicy arabica cherries year-round!   
   Natural CO2 Decaffeination :   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  Decaffeination is the act of removing caffeine from coffee beans leaving the aroma as it is. It   is carried out while the beans are still ‘green’, before they are roasted  . Drinking decaffeinated coffee is in theory, a way of enjoying the beverage while eliminating the caffeine and preserving the taste.   
 
 
 
 
  Consumer preference for natural, organic, and minimally processed foods is growing dramatically, as we all recognise that a healthy lifestyle includes not only good exercise and nutrition but also the elimination of chemicals and artificial ingredients in our food. We are using Super Critical Co2 fluid extraction process for decaffeination of coffee.  
 
 
 
 
  Benefits of this method:  
 
 
 
 
  ·     Extracts Caffeine effectively. It’s a direct contact method but does not use chemicals  .   ·     Doesn't chemically affect proteins or carbohydrates of the coffee beans.   ·     The byproducts are natural and 100% recyclable.   ·     100% organic process.  
  ·     Green process.     
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 Grade: Screen 16+  
 Varietal: 100% Arabica,  SLN. 795 
 Tasting Notes: Milk Chocolate, Mild Acidity, Balanced 
 Body: Medium 
 Altitude: 1000-1100M 
 Processing: Natural CO2 Decaffeination 
 Location:    Boothangudi,  Chikmagalur

Desc:
Jura Giga 10 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 The embodiment of a unique coffee experience 
 
 The GIGA 10 is a premium automatic specialty coffee machine that sets a new standard in performance and redefines what coffee should be. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 With two bean containers, each with its own grinder, the revolutionary cold extraction process, an innovative panorama panel for ease of use, and an intuitive new operating concept, the GIGA 10 offers a wider choice of specialty beverages than ever before. It is presented in a stunning design that impressively emphasizes the power of this unique machine. The GIGA 10 recreates the experience of barista-crafted coffee at home, transforming your kitchen into a coffee bar with just the touch of a button. 
 More choice, more options for customization 
 With a total of 35 specialty coffees, the GIGA 10 offers the widest choice of any JURA coffee machine. You can also adjust the GIGA 10 to suit your personal preferences, because the innovative user interface provides virtually unlimited options for customization. For example, why not enjoy your flat white with an extra shot of intensely flavored coffee? The range of beverages is doubled by the revolutionary cold extraction process, which gives you the option of preparing any specialty as a cold brew version. And finally, the new cold water bypass enables you to create long barista specialties. Be your own barista and enjoy an authentic coffee bar experience at home! 
 Two ceramic disc grinders for added deliciousness 
 For maximum professionalism, the GIGA 10 features not just one but two high-performance grinders made of a long-lasting, high-quality ceramic material. Two bean containers with an elegant turbine look are each connected to a separate grinder, allowing you to choose the ideal type of coffee or the optimum blend for every cup. For example, you might choose a more intense, dark roasting to make an aromatic espresso and a medium roasting for a mild lungo or coffee with milk. 
 Panorama Coffee Panel for a whole new user experience

 The sheer power and performance of the GIGA 10 are perfectly expressed by its imposing design.  Built for maximum performance

 State-of-the-art technologies for perfect enjoyment

It can also conveniently adapt to increasing requirements.

Desc:
Jura X10 - Dark Inox 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 The Jura X10 Dark Inox Coffee Machine offers a premium coffee experience with its Cold Extraction Process, delivering refreshing Cold Brews and 35 specialty drinks at the touch of a button. Designed for offices and self-service areas, it features a sleek Dark Inox finish, an intuitive 3.5-inch display, and a height-adjustable dual spout for easy operation.  Cold brews at the touch of a button 
 The X10 brings a refreshing coffee experience to offices and self-service areas with its selection of cold brews. Freshly ground at the touch of a button, not encapsulated, and cold extracted. All made possible by the Cold Extraction Process developed by JURA. In this extraction process, cold water passes through the freshly ground coffee under high pressure, pulsating at a slow rate. Name: Jura Z10 - Aluminium White - Fully Automatic Coffee Machine
Process: a quite literally refreshing top innovation. In this
Desc:
Jura Z10 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  Jura Z10, a Coffee Machine designed to perfection for the best coffee experience.  
 
 
 The groundbreaking Z10 with P.R.G. for hot and cold brew specialty coffees 
 
 A masterpiece of Swiss engineering, the new Z10 doubles the range of specialty coffees. At the touch of a button it prepares the full spectrum of hot drinks from intense espresso to on-trend flat white. It also opens up a whole new dimension in the enjoyment of coffee with the introduction of cold brew specialties. This is made possible thanks to the Product Recognizing Grinder (P.R.G.), which recognizes the chosen specialty and instantly and precisely adjusts the fineness of grind accordingly. 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 In addition, JURA has developed the pioneering Cold Extraction Process – a quite literally refreshing top innovation. In this process, cold water is slowly pulsed through the freshly ground coffee under high pressure. The result is a completely new way of experiencing coffee – refreshing, energizing and with a wonderfully balanced aroma.  
 This outstanding premium coffee machine features a double-speed 4.3” touch display and the Blue Crystal Rotary Switch. Thanks to the Specialty Selection menu, it's exceptionally easy and intuitive to use. The technological quantum leap is also reflected in the sculptural design. The convex-concave front panel is visible proof of the attention to detail and absolute manufacturing precision. Its high quality makes the Z10 a statement of excellent taste. 
 
 
 
  Brand: Jura  
  Usage Type: Home & Offices  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 The new Product Recognizing Grinder (P.R.G.) 
 To ensure the optimum grind for every specialty, JURA engineers developed the Product Recognizing Grinder (P.R.G.). The electronically controlled high-performance grinder adjusts in a fraction of a second to the predefined consistency of grind – much more quickly and frequently than could be done manually. Its spectrum ranges from very fine for short classics to very coarse for long specialties. But coffee lovers don’t need to worry, because the adjustment takes place automatically every time a beverage is prepared and, if preferred, can also be individually selected before each preparation with the Aroma Selection feature.  
 Cold brew – extreme freshness 
 Thanks to the Cold Extraction Process, the Z10 prepares genuine cold brew specialties. While many conventional cold coffee drinks consist mostly of hot-brewed coffee which is then chilled, in the Z10 extraction takes place with cold water, pulsed at high pressure, and more coarsely ground coffee. The end result is a natural, energizing and refreshing beverage in which the fruity aromas of the coffee can be fully enjoyed without being overwhelmed by bitters. Anything else would just be a cold coffee.  
 Eighth-generation brewing unit 
 The brewing unit is the most important part of any automatic coffee machine. For the Z10, JURA has created the eighth-generation brewing unit. With its unique 3D brewing technology, it allows the water to flow evenly through the ground coffee at multiple levels. This makes the most of the aroma, both in hot specialties and with cold brewing.   
 Lasting elegance 
 Design and the careful choice of materials play an important role in product durability. JURA always strives to achieve a design that people will be proud to own and that will still look fresh and modern after many years. Uncompromising quality, durable, high-quality materials and maximum engineering precision guarantee both culinary and aesthetic excellence throughout the lifetime of the machine.  A high-tech two-component method provides the surfaces with an intense sense of depth, so that just looking at the coffee machine is a pleasure in itself. The water tank with its elegant wave design and the harmonious filter casing are just two examples of the attention paid to what might seem like small details. As soon as you touch the Z10, you sense what true worth means to JURA.

Name: Saeco Magic M1 - Professional Line - Fully Automatic Coffee Machine
Desc:
Saeco Magic M1 - Fully Automatic Coffee Machine 
 
 
 
 
  Saeco knows your needs. It is designed for a world that is rapidly changing.When you feel the need for a break, you can enjoy your favourite beverage wherever you are.  
 With Magic, Saeco introduces a new and innovative family of machines that offers advanced performance, combined with modern features and a high level of design. 
  Ceramic Flat Blades. Touch Screen Interface. Customizable Recipes. External Water Connection & Drainage System. Simultaneous dispensing of 2 cups.  
 Saeco Magic M1 is your coffee Machine for your complete coffee solution. 
  Magic represents the latest evolution of coffee machines from Saeco Professional.   
  But it is also a machine that marks a clear break with the past.   
  It has new shapes, completely redesigned, and performance at the top of its category in   terms of quality and variety of beverages.   
  The coffee break becomes from a daily gesture “a way of life” to be lived with style and taste, a moment of true relaxation to pamper yourself while savouring your favourite drink.   
 
 
 
 
  Sophisticated details make Magic a desirable ‘must have’ for any high-level office. It is a machine that, for those who love coffee as much as we do, can give you pleasant moments of well-being. A machine that, when not working, becomes a furnishing accessory to be exhibited, which enriches, with a modern and innovative design, any working space.   
 
 
 
 
  The heart of Magic is a professional variable chamber unit able to hold from 8.5 to 15 g of coffee. The amount of coffee dosed can be adjusted automatically via the menu. The unit has steel conical burrs, which can   also be adjusted to obtain your favourite grind setting.   
  Magic features a new milk frothing system where the milk frother is built into the coffee dispenser. Extremely silent, it emulsifies creamy froth but can also prepare beverages with simple hot milk   
 
 
 
 
  The milk circuit is equipped with a patented cleaning system that guarantees the best efficiency after each preparation.   
  The 7’’ colour touch screen provides an easy way for navigating through the menus and a broad range of beverages. The available options also include flat white and double cappuccino, while the beverage recipes can be fully customized to suit your personal taste.   
  The coffee, milk and water dispensers are installed in a single unit. This makes it easier to position the cups and adjust them in height (from 75 to 160 mm), allowing different kinds of containers to be used.

Boothangudi Estate | Decaffeinated Coffee | High Altitude Arabica  
  An Experimental Coffee Producer in Chikmagalur, India. This estate is Classified as a "Sacred Grove" that has a special religious and cultural importance. 
 Boothangudi Estate is located at an altitude of 1000-1000 MASL and has a  Perennial water source in the estate feeding the plantation, and as drinking water for the farmers.   
   Boothangudi is named after Lord Boothappan.   A powerful deity in the estate who is meant to protect the estate from natural calamities and keeps the people safe.   Lord Boothappan also ensures timely rains, brings birds, animals and insects to play various roles in balanced flora and fauna.    "Boothan" meaning Lord boothappan & "Gudi" meaning Temple.    Boothangudi is classified as "Sacred Groves" in india dating backing to over 2000 years old.   Every year, people from as far as 900+ kms travel to this place and offer gifts to god and pray for safety and prosperity.  
  This experimental plantation also processes it's high altitude arabicas with a  Honey process which is the most labor intensive, but worth an experiment! The natural stream, perennial water source is very essential for the estate apart from timely rains. It is used for pulping, washing and irrigation purposes. The coffee also undergoes hand garbling to remove twigs, leaves and unripe fruits before the pulping process. Just another highlight of the estate is the Areca Palms providing shades to these juicy arabica cherries year-round!   
   Natural CO2 Decaffeination :   
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
 
  Decaffeination is the act of removing caffeine from coffee beans leaving the aroma as it is. It   is carried out while the beans are still ‘green’, before they are roasted  . Drinking decaffeinated coffee is in theory, a way of enjoying the beverage while eliminating the caffeine and preserving the taste.   
 
 
 
 
  Consumer preference for natural, organic, and minimally processed foods is growing dramatically, as we all recognise that a healthy lifestyle includes not only good exercise and nutrition but also the elimination of chemicals and artificial ingredients in our food. We are using Super Critical Co2 fluid extraction process for decaffeination of coffee.  
 
 
 
 
  Benefits of this method:  
 
 
 
 
  ·     Extracts Caffeine effectively. It’s a direct contact method but does not use chemicals  .   ·     Doesn't chemically affect proteins or carbohydrates of the coffee beans.   ·     The byproducts are natural and 100% recyclable.   ·     100% organic process.  
  ·     Green process.

  Estate Information - Ponnathmotte Estate  
 A 20 km drive from the scenic Madikeri town of the Coorg district in Karnataka leads you to the sprawling Ponnathmotte Estate, where the rich aroma of coffee beans engulfs you. The word ‘Ponnathmotte’ means ‘Golden Hills’ in the local language. The estate was started over 80 years ago and is now looked after by the owners’ third generation. The region is blessed with adequate rainfall, rich soil, and an ideal climate suited to growing coffee. 
 Thanks to its elevation of 3,600 ft. (1,100 m), Ponnathmotte Estate produces superior quality of Robusta & Arabica coffee seeds, as well as a special blend of hybrid variety known as CxR(Coffea congenisis and Robusta) . The estate’s immense tree canopy attracts a wide variety of migratory birds from long distances and provides a natural habitat for insects and honeybees. These factors help in better cross-pollination thus increasing the yield of Robusta. Also, thanks to the natural farming techniques employed, the coffee beans produced meet the highest quality standards. 
 Another specialty is the good number of rosewood trees that thrive in the estate and provide filter shade which is necessary for coffee plants. Cluster fig trees can be seen as well around the plantation, which not only provide shade, but its fruit cultivation is known to improve the coffee taste. Ponnathmotte Estate employs a full-time labour force who are provided individual quarters within the estate. The estate also grows other spices such as cardamom, pepper, and a few selections of fruits.

  Estate Information - Ponnathmotte Estate   
 A 20 km drive from the scenic Madikeri town of the Coorg district in Karnataka leads you to the sprawling Ponnathmotte Estate, where the rich aroma of coffee beans engulfs you. The word ‘Ponnathmotte’ means ‘Golden Hills’ in the local language. The estate was started over 80 years ago and is now looked after by the owners’ third generation. The region is blessed with adequate rainfall, rich soil, and an ideal climate suited to growing coffee.Thanks to its elevation of 3,600 ft. (1,100 m), Ponnathmotte Estate produces superior quality of Robusta & Arabica coffee seeds, as well as a special blend of hybrid variety known as CxR (Coffea congenisis and Robusta)The estate’s immense tree canopy attracts a wide variety of migratory birds from long distances and provides a natural habitat for insects and honeybees. 
 These factors help in better cross-pollination thus increasing the yield of Robusta. Also, thanks to the natural farming techniques employed, the coffee beans produced meet the highest quality standards. Another specialty is the good number of rosewood trees that thrive in the estate and provide filter shade which is necessary for coffee plants. Cluster fig trees can be seen as well around the plantation, which not only provide shade, but its fruit cultivation is known to improve the coffee taste. Ponnathmotte Estate employs a full-time labour force who are provided individual quarters within the estate. The estate also grows other spices such as cardamom, pepper, and a few selections of fruits.

Name: Authentic South Indian Brass Coffee Filter
Desc:
Bring back the ritual of slow, measured, unhurried filter coffee into your everyday. Made of solid brass, our Filter Set is designed the way it has been for generations. With simplicity. Use it to extract thick, strong, aromatic decoction from your coffee and pour it into a tumbler with intention. 
  Why Brass  
 Brass has always been part of traditional South Indian kitchens. It holds heat well, ages beautifully, and adds a certain weight to the process. It’s something you can feel in your hands every morning. 
  What’s Included  
 
 Upper chamber (for coffee powder) 
 Lower chamber (to collect decoction) 
 Press disc 
 Lid 
 
  Care Instructions  
 
 Wash gently with mild soap 
 Dry immediately to avoid water marks 
 Over time, brass may naturally darken 
 Polish occasionally if you prefer a brighter finish

Name: Hamsanādam
Process: ing is a simple traditional washed
Desc:
We have a new washed coffee and it's a revelation! 
  Perumpallam is a village on the northern  side of the lower Kodaikanal hills. The high altitude of the place is very conducive for growing complex arabicas.  
 We have been fascinated by how complex the Kodaikanal region is as a coffee growing area and have been especially curious about  the higher elevation small holder farms there. 
  The good folks at Ram estate helped us procure this interesting community arabica lot from Perumpallam. The varietal is chandragiri and the processing is a simple traditional washed. This simplicity allows the plant care and the terroir to really shine in the cup. 
  We took our time dialling in the roast of this lot but once we figured out a profile that worked, the cup really started to shine. There is oodles of milk chocolate sweetness that is punctuated by a lemon candy like acidity and marigold florals. The coffee does take some time to peak but once there we also started noticing raspberry like fruitiness too!  This complex effervescence reminded our roaster of the rāga hamsanādam. 
 Hamsanādam the coffee is a delight across all manual brews but especially the v60 , 12 days post date of roast. It also makes for a more-ish shot of espresso 24 days post date of roast! We hope to source more frequently from this high altitude corner of the Kodaikanal hills!

Name: Nalinakānti
Tasting_Notes: Last season's hit from Ram
Desc:
Last season's hit from Ram estate is back! 
 Located in the village of Kamanur near Thandigudi, Ram estate (called Rothaikadu by locals ) posseses a unique microclimate that is idealfor growing complex arabicas  and the folks there  have been processing top notch coffees from year one of their foray into the  speciality scene. 
   This particular lot consists only of  selectively picked SLN 09 arabica from the estate's highest portion. We had a hand in fine tuning the processing this lot and we thank Ram estate for listening to our suggestions. While the total fermentation time was 160 hrs, this was split between pre and post pulping. The cherries were fermented in a steel barrel with CO2 being pumped in. They were then taken out, pulped and then fermented again in similar conditionstill a total time of 160 hrs was reached.  
   The resulting cup is very aromatic ,very  tropical  and very sweet, but also shockingly 'clean' tasting ; without much fermenty notes. This is party a result of the aforementioned microclimate and partly because of careful monitoring of the cherries during fermentation and the slow drying.  The acidity tastes of lychee with a lingering raisin like sweetness and a subtle rosewater undercurrent which we find very refreshing, like the rāga nalinakānti. 
 Nalinakānti the coffee is a very sweet , complex, sippable brew  and is a delight across all manual brew methods 10 days post roasting. It makes a fruity shot of espresso 20 days post date of roast.

Name: Tōdi
Tasting_Notes: Our bold dark
Process: to eke more out of the coffee
Desc:
Our bold dark roast is back! 
 Sourced from Krishnagiri estate ,high up in the Chandra drona hills(a.k.a the Giris) of Chikmagalur, this lot of washed arabica fascinated us with its bean density and versatility(traits we have come to associate with the coffee from Krishnagiri estate). 
 Ripe cherries of the Chandrigiri varietal have been selected for this lot and the estate has tweaked their standard washed process to eke more out of the coffee. 
 Just like last year, we decided to a more developed roast apart from the medium roast; taking the beans close to second crack but stopping short of that that point. This makes the coffee stand up to milk better but retains some origin character which manifests this year and faint raspberry like fruitiness 
 The boldness of this coffee reminds us of the rāga tōdi and is our go to for milk based drinks. 
 Tōdi the coffee is a delight on the espresso machine14 days post date of roast and also works very well for  moka pot , south-indian filter and immersion brewers like French press and Aeropress.

Name: Baarbara Estate - Honey Sundried Processed
Tasting_Notes: Expect a bright, fruity aroma with notes of berries , a rounded body , and a lingering sweetness
Desc:
Baarbara Estate – Honey Processed Arabica   Single Origin | Medium Roast | Limited Estate Release  
 Nestled in the misty heights of the Western Ghats,  Baarbara Estate  is a third-generation coffee plantation run by the  Indavara family , proud cultivators of coffee since  1896  under  MG Plantations . With over 120 years of heritage and a deep-rooted commitment to sustainability, the estate is certified by both  UTZ  and the  Rainforest Alliance . 
 At elevations ranging from  3,850 to 5,350 feet , this estate produces exceptional  Selection 795 Arabica , shade-grown in rich biodiversity. The result is a coffee that truly reflects the unique terroir of  Chikmagalur , near the sacred foothills of  Bababudan Giri  India’s coffee cradle. 
 At Korebi Coffee, we collaborate closely with estates like Baarbara to  develop a roast that captures the estate’s unique character and natural expression . This year’s release is a  Honey Processed  lot, using a time-intensive and flavor-rich technique. 
 ☀️ About the Honey Sun-Dried Process: 
 In the  honey process , freshly pulped beans are  left with some of their sticky mucilage intact  and then  sun-dried on raised beds . This method named for the golden, honey-like texture of the drying beans enhances the coffee’s  natural sweetness and fruity depth , while preserving the  clarity and balance  of a washed coffee. It’s a labor of love that results in a cup with exceptional character. 
 ☕ Tasting Notes: 
 Expect a  bright, fruity aroma  with notes of  berries , a  rounded body , and a  lingering sweetness . The  medium roast  preserves the vibrant complexity of the honey process while delivering a smooth, balanced finish. 
  Key Features:  
 
 
  100% Arabica | Single Origin | Shade Grown  
 
 
  Honey Sun-Dried for Sweet, Fruit-Forward Notes  
 
 
  Ethically Sourced | UTZ & Rainforest Alliance Certified  
 
 
  Handpicked at High Elevation (3850–5350 ft)  
 
 
  Available as Whole Bean or Freshly Ground  
 
 
 Perfect for those who seek  sweet, nuanced, and expertly processed coffee ,  Baarbara Estate – Honey Processed  is a standout in our estate collection and a true expression of Indian specialty coffee done right.

Name: Briel A3 Espresso Coffee Machine with Cream Filter and Cappuccino Steamer
Bubble Bliss - Anaerobic Fermented
Tasting_Notes: Our focus was flavour while developing this blend, and we used a
Process: called Anaerobic Fermentation to achieve this
Desc:
Our focus was flavour while developing this blend, and we used a process called Anaerobic Fermentation to achieve this. This blend is made in micro batches and each batch is processed in a fully sealed vacuum chamber without the presence of any oxygen. Desc:
Pineapple Express - 2025 Harvest  
  Pineapple Fermentation | Microlot Series  
 Welcome to the cutting edge of Indian specialty coffee.  Pineapple Express  is a bold and vibrant microlot crafted at  Barbara Estate , nestled in the highlands of  Baba Budangiri, Chikmagalur . Grown at an elevation of  1550m  and fermented using ripe pineapple, this coffee is the result of pioneering post-harvest innovation - an experiment in flavor that delivers a one-of-a-kind sensory experience. 
 This  medium roast  100% Arabica coffee opens with a  winey acidity  and  sweet dried fruit aroma , evolving into notes of  apple, dried mango, vanilla, and caramel , with a whisper of spice and a refined, spirit-like finish. It's the perfect harmony of brightness and sweetness - delightfully unexpected, yet beautifully balanced. 
 Whether you brew it as espresso, French press, moka pot, or cold brew,  Pineapple Express  is a journey worth taking.   Why Pineapple Fermentation?  The pineapple not only contributes natural sugars and microbial diversity to enhance fermentation, but it also accelerates mucilage breakdown, ensuring a cleaner drying process and a mold-free bean. The result is a coffee bursting with flavor, though it doesn’t taste like pineapple, it carries the  spirit of tropical innovation  in every sip.

Name: Cafe Chic
Desc: Cafe Chic is our only South-Indian styled chicory blend, and is a tribute to the beautiful South Indian tradition of coffee drinking. The chicory (for those of you unfamiliar with chicory, it is the root of the chicory plant, which when roasted creates a flavour and aroma that is very similar to coffee, yet has a very unique taste profile. Initially considered an ‘adulterant’ because of high coffee costs during the Second World War, in France, chicory is now added to coffee to give it that distinct and unique taste). Our Chicory blended South Indian coffee has also got the extra  boldness that comes with a higher amount of Peaberry beans. We source our chicory from a farmer from one of India’s finest chicory-growing regions.

Desc:
All great home-brewed coffee starts with following recipes. And recipes include not just ingredients, but are also heavily dependent on time. 10 - 20 seconds past the recommended brewing time could lead to an over-extracted brew. 
 This simple to use coffee brewing digital timer not only helps you follow your tried and tested recipes, but also enables to make notes of what brewing times work especially for you, and therefore creating recipes of your own.

Name: Coffee Roasting Uncovered by Faiyaz and Sumit
Tasting_Notes: Step inside the
Desc:
Step inside the roastery and experience coffee beyond the cup. This immersive session takes you through the complete journey of coffee—from origin to roast. Learn about coffee-growing regions, processing methods, and the key differences between Arabica and Robusta. Dive deeper into green coffee evaluation by understanding bean structure, density, moisture content, defects, grading, and ideal storage conditions.  
  The workshop then moves into the fundamentals of coffee roasting, breaking down each stage of the roast- drying phase, Maillard reaction, caramelization, first and second crack, and development time. Participants will also gain insight into roast profile control, including time-temperature balance, airflow management, and development percentage.  
  The session concludes with a   live roasting demonstration  , offering a practical look at how theory translates into flavor. Designed for curious beginners and coffee enthusiasts alike, this workshop is a hands-on introduction to the science and craft behind great coffee.

Name: Cold brew - New Orleans Style
Tasting_Notes: Chocolate, Toffee
Desc:
Our New Orleans Style of cold brew is a blend of dark roasted  honey sun-dried coffee and roasted chicory root. This blend produces a strong, rich, deep and flavourful cold brew concentrate that tastes divine with a few ice cubes and some milk. Or condensed milk.   
 A quick history lesson? Thanks to the French influence in New Orleans, roasted chicory root added to roasted coffee became a thing among the locals. Initially meant to make coffee beans last longer thanks to the shortage caused during the war, this unique flavour in the brew developed a huge fan following well past the years of war.  
 Try this style of cold brew, especially if you like cold brew with milk or ice cream or cream or almond milk or condensed milk or.. ok, we're going to stop now.

Desc:

Name: Friends of the Farmer - 2 Farmers, 1 Estate!
Process: and the craft behind every cup
Desc:
A Coffee Storytelling & Tasting Evening  
     
  Join us for an intimate hour with the people behind the cup- the growers, dreamers and experimenters who bring our coffee to life.   
     
  Estate Details-  
  On this special evening, meet Nisha & Kurian, the duo that left their concrete jungle lives in Bengaluru to move to Anai Kadu - Pottamkulam, a mindful coffee farm situated on the border of the Devamachi Reserve Forest in Kodagu.

  Hear from Kurian & Nisha about life on the farm, sharing space with wildlife and the effects of climate change on their crops.  
     
  Learn how biodiversity and wild microbes shape the flavours in your cup - showcasing an coffee that is an homage to the Western Ghats - a rare Canephora lot from 70+ year old plants, fermented using native cultures isolated from wild figs on the farm.  
     
  Also Featuring: Home-Brewer Showcase  
     
  Experience this same coffee brewed in different styles by Rohan & Aditi, curated by Arpan Ramtek- passionate home brewers who will present their interpretation of this experimental coffee. Taste how brewing choices completely transform the same beans into unique flavour expressions.  
     
  Indulge in exclusive tastings, paired snacklings, and conversation with a community that celebrates origin, process and the craft behind every cup.

Name: Melkodige estate - single origin Arabica
Tasting_Notes: Fig, Ripe Plum
Desc:
Melkodige estate, located in Chikmagalur (karnataka) at an altitude of 4000 feet is home to some of the finest coffees in the country.The farmer couple - Aveen and Yogitha nurture a diverse range of species of coffee plants and have built infrastructure for processing and fermentation that serves as a sort of a benchmark in this region.  
 The estate itself, heavily wooded, is home to over 9000 plant species, 500 bird species and 139 animal species.  
 The coffees are sweet, full of character and truly enjoyable.  
 Bean: Arabica, SLN 9  
 Process: Anaerobic Naturals 
 Roast Profile: Medium to medium dark. 
  Tasting notes: Fig, Ripe Plum

Name: Ol' Smoky - Cold Smoked coffee!
Tasting_Notes: Sweet smoke
Desc:
The world's first cold-smoked coffee is now in its fourth year! For those who love a mellow, sweet-smoky lining to their favourite drink, this Maverick creation is for them. Freshly pulped arabica green beans are cold-smoked for 13-14 hours in a smokehouse to create this unusual, exquisite coffee. You will best enjoy this black or slow cold-brewed with a touch of milk. Pour-over brewing will help retain most of the fruity-smokiness.  
 Ol' Smoky by Maverick & Farmer is a micro-lot coffee, we have a limited batch this year.   
 Watch a video that explains how we make this beautiful coffee  
     
 Bean: Arabica 
 Process: Washed, cold-smoked 
 Roast Profile: medium-light 
 Tasting notes: Sweet smoke, roasted spice.

Name: Orange You Curious?
Tasting_Notes: Citrus, cherry wine
Desc:
Orange You Curious? is an orange juice fermented coffee. Our freshly pulped arabica beans go through a unique barrel fermentation process with orange juice (from our orange trees on the coffee farm) for 24 hours. The natural yeasts present on the orange skins, as well as the coffee skins, work on the fruit sugars and produce some truly unique flavours and fragrances.  
 This coffee was first created in 2020 as a tiny microlot, and it is today one of our fastest-selling favourites! 
 Enjoy this coffee black or with a tiny amount of milk. Cold-brewing Orange You Curious is awesome too! 
 Orange You Curious? from the Maverick & Farmer is a micro-lot coffee; we have a limited batch this year. 
 
 
 Bean: Arabica 
 Process: Washed, primary, and secondary fermented 
 Roast Profile: medium-light 
 Tasting notes: Citrus, cherry wine.

Desc:

Parama is great with milk, but is also nice as a black coffee that's slightly on the deeper side. Parama is a medium roast coffee.  
  Parama has notes of chocolate and caramel. Parama is the house blend that's served in our cafes in Bangalore and Delhi.

 Process: Multiple processes - Washed, natural, honey, smoked. 
 Roast Profile: Medium to Medium-dark

Name: Pour over coffee brewer - Ceramic by Maverick & Farmer
Tasting_Notes: from your single
Desc:
Hand made with some truly fine craftsmanship, this ceramic pour-over brewer is perfect for home brewing when you want only the cleanest tasting notes from your single-origin coffee. Pour-over brewing is a brewing process that does not allow for much 'immersion' of your coffee grinds in water, with constant replenishment of water. Therefore what you get is a flavourful cup with no over-extraction or extended bitterness. Watch our videos on pour-over brewing to master this technique.  
 Pour over coffee brewing is highly addictive! The aroma release, the circular method of pouring, arriving at your own final recipe of water-to-coffee-powder etc can make this a very immersive method of brewing.  
 If you know of someone who is really into coffee, this is a perfect hand-crafted gift too! 
 This pour-over filter works with v60 size 2 filter papers.  
 All our ceramic products are handmade with natural materials, so consistency of colour and shape may vary.

Name: South Indian Brass Filter
Desc:
Made of pure brass, this is a traditional brewing equipment for home use, or makes for a perfect gift. The South Indian brass filter extracts a strong brew, giving the coffee a heavy-body, packed with flavour and aroma. 
 The lid at the top of the filter has a little handle made of wood, and this gives the filter an elegant look, as well as makes it convenient to open and shut the lid when the entire apparatus is hot.  
 Coffee powder is put into the upper chamber and hot water is added. This is placed over the lower chamber and the coffee is allowed to drip slowly. The resultant brew is thick and concentrated, and full of flavour. Add this to hot milk or hot water.

The fruitiness from the pulp gets into the bean and creates a fruity, citrussy cup. Sunkissed is an award-winning specialty Robusta. 
 Bean: Robusta 
 Process: Honey Sun-dried 
 Roast Profile: Dark, just past the first crack. 
 Tasting notes: Fruity, citrus, buttercup.

Name: The Coffee and Cheese pairing workshop with Käse
Desc:
While pairing cheese and coffee may not be commonplace, it isn’t very difficult to think of them together! Think of a ricotta bar with coffee or a more indulgent Basque cheesecake. How can     we forget the freshly brewed filter coffee decoction with frothy milk or cappuccino,     macchiatos     or a     cortado    ! Milk with its proteins and fats play an important role in making the coffee enjoyable but cheese with its sensory qualities and textures adds a di    fferent dimension.   
   Bhavi Patel A dairy technologist & brand building specialist with a keen interest in foodomics & neurogastronomy, Bhavi loves telling stories, experimenting with ingredients & pairings, and nerding out over the science behind food.   
   Namrata Sundaresan Namrata, is the Co-founder of Käse. Armed with a degree in business management and 15 years in international trade & Investment consulting it was the love of food that got her Introduced to cheesemaking! Her extensive travels introduced her to excellent cheeses across the world.

Name: The Maverick Coffee Experience: Farm to Cup
Tasting_Notes: body, and aroma like a true coffee taster. 2
Desc:
The Maverick Coffee Experience: Farm to Cup   
 An immersive, guided journey into the world of specialty coffee- crafted for both curious beginners and coffee lovers alike by Faiyaz Tharakar. At Maverick & Farmer, we take you beyond just drinking coffee and into truly experiencing it- understanding its origin, process, flavour, and craft. 
 Over the course of this session, you’ll explore a curated selection of coffees through multiple formats, designed to help you taste, compare, and engage with coffee in a more meaningful way. 
   What to Expect   
  1. Coffee Cupping (30 mins)  Begin with a classic cupping session where you’ll taste 3-4 distinct coffees side by side- featuring profiles like Washed, Monsoon Malabar, and Modur Naturals. Learn to identify flavour notes, body, and aroma like a true coffee taster. 
  2. Brew Comparison (20 mins)  Experience how brewing changes everything. Taste the same coffee prepared using two different methods and understand how technique impacts flavour, texture, and balance. 
  3. Pairing Experience (15 mins)  Discover the art of pairing coffee with complementary desserts- bringing out hidden notes and enhancing the overall tasting experience. 
  4. Interactive Segment (10 mins)  Put your senses to the test with fun activities like blind tasting and aroma identification—making the session engaging and memorable. 
  5. Closing & Retail Experience (5 mins)  Wrap up the session with an opportunity to take home your favourite coffees. Enjoy a Rs 250 voucher towards retail purchases of the beans you’ve just explored. 
  When? At 4:30 PM, on 4th April, 2026  
 
 Where? Kothanur, Maverick, and Farmer Outlet.  
 
  Limited spots, so book your seats now!

Name: The work-from-home kit - Discounted price!
Desc:
A simple, easy to use work-from-home coffee kit to make endless cups of coffee through the day! This set comes with a stylish and futuristic TimeMore French Press that comes with a superior steel superfine filter and an additional filter for pouring, an artisanal handmade Maverick & Farmer ceramic cup (find out  more ) and a 250 gm pack of  Parama  by Maverick & Farmer.  
 The French Press makes a rich brew that's full of body and flavour. As you gain experience with this method of brewing you will very soon be able to vary brewing times and play with coffee dosage to create your own brewing recipes that work best for you.  
 If you like your coffee with a milk, then you can use this same kit to make a home-style 'cappuccino' or a 'latte'. Watch these  videos  to find out how! 
 This kit which costs Rs. 2,539 with shipping is available as a set at Rs. 2,300 with FREE SHIPPING!

Name: Two Beans In A Pod
Tasting_Notes: Chocolate (obviously!), Ripe Plum
Desc:
Cocoa beans, like coffee beans, go through a similar fermentation process once harvested and scooped out of the pod. Fermentation gives the beans a complexity in flavour apart from being necessary to prepare the beans for the next step - roasting..  
 With Two Beans In A Pod, we've developed a unique method of fermenting freshly harvested beans of both cocoa and coffee, allowing a whole new world of microbes and sugar seeking bio-reactions to take over the process and in turn creating some really ingenious and beautiful flavours.  
 Two Beans In A Pod is part of our 6 Maverick coffees for 21/22. 
  
 Bean: Single estate Arabica coffee and Malnad Cocoa 
 Process: Washed, primary and secondary fermented 
 Roast Profile: medium 
 Tasting notes: Chocolate (obviously!), Ripe Plum

Name: 100% Pure Arabica | Pure South Indian Filter Coffee, No Chicory
Desc:
MokkaFarms 100% Pure South Indian Filter Coffee Powder  
 Indulge in the authentic taste of South India with MokkaFarms’  100% Arabica Filter Coffee powder . 
 Crafted using the  finest quality coffee beans , this coffee is  roasted to perfection  to deliver a rich, aromatic coffee with a distinct and traditional South Indian flavor. 
   
  Why Choose MokkaFarms Filter Coffee?  
 
 
 PURE & NATURAL : Made with  100% natural ingredients , free from preservatives and artificial additives. 
 
 RICH & AROMATIC : A traditional blend offering a bold yet smooth flavor that coffee lovers cherish. 
 
 CUSTOMIZABLE BREW : Adjust the quantity to suit your taste—strong and bold or mild and smooth. 
 
   
  Long-Lasting Freshness  Our coffee powder is carefully packaged in a one-way-valve zip-lock bag, preserving its  freshness, aroma, and flavor . Enjoy a freshly brewed cup any time, with the quality and care that only MokkaFarms provides. 
   
  How to Choose your Grind Size  
 
 
 Fine Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be high/ strong 
 
 
 Regular/ Medium Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be moderate/ regular/ medium 
 
 
 Coarse Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be light/ mild 
 
 
 Electric Drip Grind  - Use this if you have an Electric Drip Machine 
 
   
  How to Brew  
 
 Add the desired amount of coffee powder to your coffee filter. 
 Pour hot water over the powder and let it  drip slowly  into a cup or vessel. 
 Add milk and sugar to taste, and enjoy the  authentic flavors of South Indian coffee . 
 
   
  Proudly Made in India  Celebrate the tradition of South Indian filter coffee with every sip of our premium-quality coffee powder, made with love and affection.

MokkaFarms brings you an exclusive High Quality, Estate Coffee, Fresh Roast, 100% Pure, 30% mix each of Robusta Whole Coffee Beans and Arabica Whole Coffee Beans from Coorg/ Chikmagalur region of Western Ghats, Karnataka, India. Our coffee beans are further selectively picked to ensure that you have a superior grade coffee beans. The beans are carefully selected and roasted, separately in small batches, to perfection as per the roast type and pack size that you need, to create a strong, flavorful and an extremely gratifying and a rich aromatic coffee experience. The result is a smooth and balanced cup of coffee with a unique flavor profile. The 80% Arabica-20% Robusta Roasted Whole Coffee Beans Blend from Mokka Farms gives the coffee a strong and fruity taste with a hint of chocolate. The brewing method enhances the flavors and aromas, resulting in a full-bodied and satisfying cup of coffee. The coffee with the blend beans can be enjoyed hot or cold and is perfect for those who appreciate a strong and flavorful coffee. Whether you prefer a classic cup of black coffee or a creamy and sweet latte, this coffee blend will satisfy your cravings. Indulge in the rich and authentic taste of one of the best Arabica-Robusta Coffee Beans Blend that you can find in the country.  Proudly Made in India!   
 
  FLAVOURFUL COFFEE:    Treat yourself to the exquisite flavors of MokkaFarms 100% Pure, 70% Arabica-30% Robusta Roasted Whole Coffee Beans Blend, a sensory experience  like no other  
 
   FARM to FORK: From planting, harvesting, grading, roasting, grinding to processing and packaging, we carefully track every step of the coffee production process to give high quality and maintain consistency   
 
  HANDCRAFTED: Our coffee is carefully handcrafted in small batches to deliver a rich and remarkable flavor, strength and aroma while ensuring consistency  
  AROMATIC, GREAT TASTE, STRONG:    Our 50% Arabica-50% Robusta Roasted Whole Coffee Beans Blend has a toasty aroma and a velvety taste, and is strong yet flavourful  !   
  CONVENIENCE, REUSABLE PACKAGING: Comes in a convenient, tamper-proof, one-way valve, resealable zip-lock pouch for maximum freshness!

Name: Aero Press - 100% Pure Arabica | A/ AA Grade | Premium Ground Coffee
Tasting_Notes: ☕ Premium Ground Coffee – 100% Pure Arabica by Mokka
Desc:
☕  Premium Ground Coffee – 100% Pure Arabica by MokkaFarms 
 
    🇮🇳 Made with love in India, for true coffee lovers.  

   Discover the luxurious taste of  MokkaFarms Premium Ground Coffee  – made from  100% pure, sun-dried Arabica beans  handpicked from the lush plantations of  Coorg and Chikmagalur  in Karnataka’s Western Ghats.

     📦  Smart Packaging  – Resealable, one-way valve pouch locks in aroma till the last scoop. 
   

    Whether you like it hot or cold, black or with milk – this blend delivers a  premium café-style experience  right at home.  

    ✨ Indulge in the best of Indian Arabica. Taste it, sip by sip.

Name: Black | 20% Arabica, 80% Robusta | Pure South Indian Filter Coffee, No Chicory
Desc:
MokkaFarms 100% Pure South Indian Filter Coffee Powder  
 Indulge in the authentic taste of South India with MokkaFarms’  Black [20% Arabica, 80% Robusta] Filter Coffee powder . 
 Crafted using the  finest quality coffee beans , this coffee blend is  roasted to perfection  to deliver a rich, aromatic coffee with a distinct and traditional South Indian flavor. 
   
  Why Choose MokkaFarms Filter Coffee?  
 
 
 PURE & NATURAL : Made with  100% natural ingredients , free from preservatives and artificial additives. 
 
 RICH & AROMATIC : A traditional blend offering a bold yet smooth flavor that coffee lovers cherish. 
 
 CUSTOMIZABLE BREW : Adjust the quantity to suit your taste—strong and bold or mild and smooth. 
 
   
  Long-Lasting Freshness  Our coffee powder is carefully packaged in a one-way-valve zip-lock bag, preserving its  freshness, aroma, and flavor . Enjoy a freshly brewed cup any time, with the quality and care that only MokkaFarms provides. 
   
  How to Choose your Grind Size  
 
 
 Fine Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be high/ strong 
 
 
 Regular/ Medium Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be moderate/ regular/ medium 
 
 
 Coarse Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be light/ mild 
 
 
 Electric Drip Grind  - Use this if you have an Electric Drip Machine 
 
   
  How to Brew  
 
 Add the desired amount of coffee powder to your coffee filter. 
 Pour hot water over the powder and let it  drip slowly  into a cup or vessel. 
 Add milk and sugar to taste, and enjoy the  authentic flavors of South Indian coffee . 
 
   
  Proudly Made in India  Celebrate the tradition of South Indian filter coffee with every sip of our premium-quality coffee powder, made with love and affection.

Name: Exuberance | 90% Coffee, 10% Chicory | Robusta-Chicory Filter Coffee
Desc:
MokkaFarms South Indian Filter Coffee Powder – Exuberance   
 Discover the perfect blend of tradition and flavor with MokkaFarms’  Exuberance . 
 This premium South Indian filter coffee powder features an  90% coffee  and  10% chicory mix , creating a rich, robust, and aromatic experience. 
   
  Crafted to Perfection  
 
 Made from  finest coffee beans , carefully selected and roasted to perfection to bring out their natural flavors. 
 
 Chicory  adds a deep, earthy note that complements the coffee, enhancing its overall richness. 
 
   
  Authentic South Indian Taste  Specially designed for the  traditional filter coffee method , this blend delivers a smooth, satisfying texture and full-bodied flavor. Ideal for those who appreciate a  strong, flavorful cup of coffee . 
   
  How to Choose your Grind Size  
 
 
 Fine Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be high/ strong 
 
 
 Regular/ Medium Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be moderate/ regular/ medium 
 
 
 Coarse Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be light/ mild 
 
 
 Electric Drip Grind  - Use this if you have an Electric Drip Machine 
 
   
  How to Brew  
 
 Add the desired amount of coffee powder to your coffee filter. 
 Pour hot water over the powder and let it  drip slowly  into a cup or vessel. 
 Add milk and sugar to taste, and enjoy the  authentic flavors of South Indian coffee . 
 
   
  Proudly Made in India  Celebrate the vibrant tradition of South Indian coffee with our  Exuberance coffee , crafted with care to deliver a truly special coffee-drinking experience.

Name: Indulgence | 70% Coffee, 30% Chicory | Robusta-Chicory Filter Coffee
Desc:
MokkaFarms South Indian Filter Coffee Powder – Indulgence   
 Discover the perfect blend of tradition and flavor with MokkaFarms’  Indulgence . 
 This premium South Indian filter coffee powder features an  70% coffee  and  30% chicory mix , creating a rich, robust, and aromatic experience. 
   
  Crafted to Perfection  
 
 Made from  finest coffee beans , carefully selected and roasted to perfection to bring out their natural flavors. 
 
 Chicory  adds a deep, earthy note that complements the coffee, enhancing its overall richness. 
 
   
  Authentic South Indian Taste  Specially designed for the  traditional filter coffee method , this blend delivers a smooth, satisfying texture and full-bodied flavor. Ideal for those who appreciate a  strong, flavorful cup of coffee . 
   
  How to Choose your Grind Size  
 
 
 Fine Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be high/ strong 
 
 
 Regular/ Medium Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be moderate/ regular/ medium 
 
 
 Coarse Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be light/ mild 
 
 
 Electric Drip Grind  - Use this if you have an Electric Drip Machine 
 
   
  How to Brew  
 
 Add the desired amount of coffee powder to your coffee filter. 
 Pour hot water over the powder and let it  drip slowly  into a cup or vessel. 
 Add milk and sugar to taste, and enjoy the  authentic flavors of South Indian coffee . 
 
   
  Proudly Made in India  Celebrate the vibrant tradition of South Indian coffee with our  Indulgence coffee , crafted with care to deliver a truly special coffee-drinking experience.

Name: Ranya | 60% Arabica, 35% Robusta, 5% Chicory | Arabica-Robusta-Chicory Filter Coffee
Desc:
MokkaFarms South Indian Filter Coffee Powder – Ranya   
 Discover the perfect blend of tradition and flavor with MokkaFarms’  Ranya .  The coffee is made using the one of the finest quality coffee beans and chicory, which are carefully roasted to perfection.

  Crafted to Perfection  
 
 Made from  finest coffee beans , carefully selected and roasted to perfection to bring out their natural flavors. 
 
 Chicory  adds a deep, earthy note that complements the coffee, enhancing its overall richness.

  How to Choose your Grind Size  
 
 
 Fine Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be high/ strong 
 
 
 Regular/ Medium Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be moderate/ regular/ medium 
 
 
 Coarse Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be light/ mild 
 
 
 Electric Drip Grind  - Use this if you have an Electric Drip Machine 
 
   
  How to Brew  
 
 Add the desired amount of coffee powder to your coffee filter. 
 Pour hot water over the powder and let it  drip slowly  into a cup or vessel. 
 Add milk and sugar to taste, and enjoy the  authentic flavors of South Indian coffee . 
 
   
  Proudly Made in India  Celebrate the vibrant tradition of South Indian coffee with our  Ranya  coffee, crafted with care to deliver a truly special coffee-drinking experience.

Name: Supreme  | 40% Arabica, 60% Robusta | Pure South Indian Filter Coffee, No Chicory
Desc:
MokkaFarms 100% Pure South Indian Filter Coffee Powder  
 Indulge in the authentic taste of South India with MokkaFarms’  Supreme [40% Arabica, 60% Robusta] Filter Coffee powder . 
 Crafted using the  finest quality coffee beans , this coffee blend is  roasted to perfection  to deliver a rich, aromatic coffee with a distinct and traditional South Indian flavor. 
   
  Why Choose MokkaFarms Filter Coffee?  
 
 
 PURE & NATURAL : Made with  100% natural ingredients , free from preservatives and artificial additives. 
 
 RICH & AROMATIC : A traditional blend offering a bold yet smooth flavor that coffee lovers cherish. 
 
 CUSTOMIZABLE BREW : Adjust the quantity to suit your taste—strong and bold or mild and smooth. 
 
   
  Long-Lasting Freshness  Our coffee powder is carefully packaged in a one-way-valve zip-lock bag, preserving its  freshness, aroma, and flavor . Enjoy a freshly brewed cup any time, with the quality and care that only MokkaFarms provides. 
   
  How to Choose your Grind Size  
 
 
 Fine Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be high/ strong 
 
 
 Regular/ Medium Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be moderate/ regular/ medium 
 
 
 Coarse Grind  -    Use this if you want the strength of your coffee/ decoction to be light/ mild 
 
 
 Electric Drip Grind  - Use this if you have an Electric Drip Machine 
 
   
  How to Brew  
 
 Add the desired amount of coffee powder to your coffee filter. 
 Pour hot water over the powder and let it  drip slowly  into a cup or vessel. 
 Add milk and sugar to taste, and enjoy the  authentic flavors of South Indian coffee . 
 
   
  Proudly Made in India  Celebrate the tradition of South Indian filter coffee with every sip of our premium-quality coffee powder, made with love and affection.

Desc: Our search for the immaculate espresso began when we were embraced by the warm welcome of Ramdev and his parents Shantha and Nagesh as we drove through the gates of Bettadamalali Estate in early 2023. A pristine farm nestled in the Baba Budan Giri hills of Chikmagalur, this place is more than a commercial operation – it is a garden of nature’s best delights. With scientific approaches to farming complemented by highly structured operations, Bettadamalali produce some of the best washed Arabicas we have encountered in recent times. The farm has been a long-term partner to our sister enterprise Indcaffe – who have over the years exported several hundreds of tons of washed Arabica for them to specialty houses in Europe. We decided to grab our own little share of the treasure as we cycled through multiple lots to find this gem that would help us curate a delicious espresso.

BEWILD have worked closely with a team of growers, roasters, and brewers to cultivate this coffee in a sustainable and ethical way, embracing the principles of permaculture and biodiversity conservation. The result is a distinct coffee experience that celebrates the wildness of the forest and the magic of nature.

Tasting_Notes: Within each cherry on the coffee tree, two beans are grown side by side, resulting in the flat face of most
Desc:
Most coffee beans are born twins.  Within each cherry on the coffee tree, two beans are grown side by side, resulting in the flat face of most beans.Peaberries, however, occur when only one of the two seeds is fertilized, growing on its own without anything to flatten it.  
 As a result of heir independence, peaberry observes all the goodness.  Many coffee connoisseurs have suggested that each peaberry in infused with all the assets normally reserved for two beans.  These beans are most certainly unique and livelier cup with sweeter and bright taste, so giving special liquoring .

Name: ONCE Upon a FARM Mylemoney Single Origin Coffee
Tasting_Notes: Toasted Nuts, Cinnamon (Expect a bright cup with fair and delicate mouthfeel
Desc:
Once upon a Farm Mylemoney Estate Single Origin Coffee 
 ORIGIN: MYLEMONEY, CHIKMAGALUR ALTITUDE: 1220 M Above MSL Tasting Notes: Toasted Nuts, Cinnamon (Expect a bright cup with fair and delicate mouthfeel, along with hints of toasted nuts & cinnamon.) 
 contains 100% coffee 0% Chicory  
 Panduranga Plantation, nestled in the scenic beauty of Mylemoney, the magnanimous location within the Mullayanagiri mountain range, boasts lush green forests and serves as a habitat for rich wildlife. It’s history dates back to the early 19th century when the legendary British planter, Thomas Cannon, discovered this ideal location to grow Coffee. Cannon’s vision led to the establishment of one of the finest coffee estates in the region. By the 1860s, the reputation of Mylemoney’s coffee, branded as Cannon’s Coffee, had spread even to the London market, attesting to its exceptional quality. This was the first place where coffee was cultivated commercially in India. Also Mylemoney is renowned for growing one of the earliest varieties of Arabica coffee, known as the Kent, celebrated for it’s exquisite cupping quality and the magical flavors it imparts. Panduranga plantations takes pride in being part of this timeless heritage, cherishing its legacy and contributing to the continued excellence of the region’s coffee industry

Name: HONEY SUN DRIED COFFEE
Desc:
The micro - lot is meticulously crafted using fully ripened hand picked coffee cherries. 
 Its name is inspired by the cherries and the unique processing method used.  The cherries are carefully hand picked at their peak ripeness, when they are vibrant red in color.  They are then de-pulped and skillfully sun dried with the honey-like mucilage intact, followed by shade processing.  
 Shade processing slows the drying process, allowing for higher fermentation of the beans.  This enhance the coffee's natural sweetness giving it a flavor profile reminiscent of a touch of honey, making it one of our finest roasts

Desc: Monsoon Malabar is one of India’s most legendary coffee styles born along the Malabar Coast, shaped by nature, and cherished for its unmistakable flavour. Originally discovered when wooden-hulled ships carried Indian coffee to Europe, the beans would swell, mellow, and transform during the long sea voyages through the monsoon winds. Today, this naturally occurring phenomenon is carefully recreated in controlled warehouses along the coast.Exposed to moist monsoon winds for several weeks, the beans undergo a slow, deliberate transformation: their colour turns pale gold, their size nearly doubles, and their acidity softens beautifully. The result is a bold, smooth, and earthy cup with notes of spice, wood, cocoa, and a gentle sweetness, finishing with a low-acid, rounded body that makes it perfect for espresso and milk-based drinks.At Roastery Coffee House, our Monsoon Malabar celebrates India’s heritage an ode to tradition, craftsmanship, and the unique terroir of the Western Ghats. Name: Ratnagiri Hydro Honey (SCA 86+)
Tasting_Notes: This lot from Ratnagiri
Process: ing to create a cup with layered complexity and clarity
Desc:
This lot from  Ratnagiri Estate, Chikmagalur  is a refined expression of the  Hydro Honey process,  a method that  blends elements of washed, natural, and honey processing  to create a cup with layered complexity and clarity. 
 Ripe cherries are carefully selected  based on their sugar content  to ensure peak sweetness. They are first sun-dried briefly like a natural, then  rehydrated (soaked)  to refine the profile, before  being depulped and slowly dried again  with controlled mucilage, similar to a honey process. This multi-stage approach is labour-intensive but results in exceptional balance and depth. 
 The cup is delicate and expressive, opening with notes of  peach tea and soft florals . A clean  sugarcane sweetness  runs through, with layers of  stone fruit  add gentle juiciness and depth as the cup cools. 
  Light roasted  to preserve its vibrancy, this coffee is bright, elegant, and structured, ideal for  Pour-over, AeroPress, and other manual brews.

Name: Yelnoorkhan Yeast Anaerobic Honey (SCA 85+)
Desc: Yelnoorkhan Anaerobic Honey coffee is produced using a method that combines anaerobic fermentation with honey processing. In this process, the coffee cherries are fermented in an oxygen-free environment, which enhances their fruity acidity and aromatic complexity. Following this, the beans are pulped and dried with some of the sticky mucilage (the 'honey') still attached, further enriching the coffee's sweetness and body. The resulting brew is lauded for its vibrant, grapes-like brightness, layered fruit notes, and a rich, raisin-like sweetness. These characteristics create a smooth and rounded mouthfeel, highlighting both the precision of controlled fermentation and the inherent qualities of the coffee's origin. This coffee is roasted to a medium level which allows us to brew it for both manual brews and complex espressos.

Name: Cascara
Desc:
Cascara stands as a testament to the principles of the circular economy movement, transforming coffee fruit peels, typically discarded, into a valuable product. This innovative approach involves processing the overlooked byproduct into a brew reminiscent of fruity loose leaf tea or incorporating it into artisanal baking. 
 The introduction of single origin cascara serves a dual purpose. Primarily, it aims to create a continuous cycle of value for our producer partners at the source. Secondly, it seeks to highlight the rich sensory diversity of microlot Cascara, an often overlooked byproduct of the coffee industry. This mirrors the existing appreciation for the varied profiles found in coffee itself, presenting a new dimension to the overall coffee experience.

Name: Excelsa
Tasting_Notes: Lychee / Jackfruit / Ripe Banana Sweetness
Desc:
Excelsa — Mooleh Manay Estate, Coorg  
  Origin  
 Grown amidst the serene backwaters of the Harangi Reservoir in Coorg, Mooleh Manay Estate is a fourth- generation farm now led by Komal and Akshay Dashrath. With 75 acres of clay-loamy soil and 65 inches of annual rainfall, their approach blends data-driven precision with a deep respect for nature. Every cherry is selectively hand-picked, fermented with intent, and dried with patience each step reflecting the care and curiosity that define their craft. 
  About the Producer  
 The estate works closely with the South India Coffee Company (SICC)  a green coffee collective committed to transparency, traceability, and research. Through SICC Labs, the company explores low- intervention species and climate-resilient coffee farming, charting a sustainable future for Indian coffee. 
  Why Excelsa  
 While most of the world’s attention rests on Arabica and Robusta, Excelsa remains a quiet outlier. A rare coffee species that bridges intensity and intrigue. Once grown along farm borders in India, Excelsa trees tower high and challenge harvesters with their wild nature. Yet within their small, round beans lies an extraordinary spectrum of flavor — bright, juicy, and surprisingly complex. 
 The Mooleh Manay Excelsa lot we roast has been DNA-verified by the Royal Botanic Gardens, Kew, and naturally carries a low caffeine content (0.9–0.98%) without compromising on depth. Even in milk-based brews, it retains its vivid fruit character, a rarity in the world of coffee. 
  Processing  
 This lot underwent an 84-hour yeast-inoculated natural fermentation, sealed in oxygen-restricted tanks to create a carbonic maceration environment. 
 - Harvesting: Only fully ripe cherries - hand-picked one by one. 
 - Sorting: Water flotation ensures uniform density and ripeness. 
 - Fermentation: Controlled yeast fermentation deepens sweetness and clarity. 
 - Drying: Slow, steady drying on raised beds within polyhouses. 
 - Resting: After reaching 11–12% moisture, the coffee rests for two months to allow its flavors to mature naturally. 
  Cup Profile  
 A cup that bursts with layered berry complexity, rounded by notes of sweet cherry and lychee. Low in caffeine, yet high in character - Excelsa is a reminder that beauty often thrives in the margins. 
  At Siolim  
 We roast this coffee to celebrate its unconventional story, a species often overlooked, rediscovered with care. Excelsa challenges our understanding of what Indian coffee can be: wild, bold, and beautifully untamed.

This process highlights the coffee's intrinsic flavors, bringing out the rich notes of dark chocolate, cherry fruit, and raisins, making it a clean and vibrant cup grown at 1350 MASL

Name: Raxidi Lobo's P1 Natural
Tasting_Notes: Cloves / Chocolate / Dark Cherry
Desc: The finest coffee cherries were selectively picked, then thoroughly washed and placed in a stainless steel container. A P1 strain, a mix of yeast and bacteria, was then introduced to ferment the cherries in an anaerobic environment for 18 hours. Once fermentation was complete, the cherries were transferred to raised beds for slow drying over 21 days. Throughout the drying process, the temperature and humidity were carefully monitored to maintain a controlled environment.

Name: Rum Barrel Aged
Tasting_Notes: Milk Chocolate / Jackfruit / Molases
Desc: For the Rum barrel-aged process, we started it with soaking oak barrels in rum for 30 days, allowing the wood to absorb its rich, tropical flavors. Once seasoned, the barrels are emptied and filled with Ratnagiri Estate's natural processed beans. Over the next 45 days, the beans absorb the rum essence, resulting in a smooth coffee with hints of rum's sweetness.

Desc:
Single Origin Arabica Microlot from Coorg, Karnataka, India  
  Medium Roast (200g)  
  Process : Carbonic Macerated 
  Varietal:  Excelsa 
  Agtron Meter:  63 
  Best Suited:  Filter Roast 
  Cupper's Notes:  Champagne, Green Grapes, Dry Dates. 
 
    
 
   
 Best Brewed With   
 
  FILTER ROAST    Manual brewing methods fall under the artisanal brewing style of coffee. Roasting a coffee is also an art, we have developed this filter roast to maintain the quality while brewing over Pour over, Kalita, V60, Origami, April, Chemex.   Please note that the best brewed with list is not comprehensive and does not dictate that the coffees cannot be brewed with any other methods. These are the the methods we think will extract the best possible cup. However, this coffee can be ground and enjoyed with any brew method that you desire.    
 
   About the Process 
 
   84 Hours Yeast Inoculated Natural :  The coffee undergoes a meticulous process beginning with selective harvesting—only ripe cherries are hand-picked, sometimes using ladders—and cleaned via flotation to remove low-density beans and debris. The cherries then undergo 84 hours of carbonic maceration fermentation, inoculated with Saccharomyces cerevisiae yeast to enhance flavor. After fermentation, the coffee is dried in a polyhouse, then moved to raised beds and raked regularly for even drying. Once moisture reaches 11–12%, the beans are carefully bagged for storage.  
   
 
 
  About the Roast  
   Medium Roast  :  At Subko, a Medium roast is one that is obtained by dropping the coffee lot at 201°-204°C. These roasts are generally of a sensory profile that is very smooth, caramel and complex tropical fruits. In terms of the Agtron scale, Subko's definition of medium lies between the points 60 to 74, with 74 being the lightest version of a medium roast, and 60 being the darkest version of the roast.

  Flavor Meter  
   
 
 Cupper's Notes  
 
 
 
 
 
 
 This coffee lot, roasted for an espresso brew or strong extraction, boasts a flavor profile reminiscent of sweet honey and walnuts, coupled with a heavy body. It features a prolonged, brown sugar-like finish and notes of caramel candy. The mellow, citric aftertaste is akin to that of a semi-ripe dragon fruit. 
 
 
 
 
 
  About Subko VLGE: Co-operative Agriculture  
 A sustainable, farm-to-table-to-farmer operation by Subko 
   Founded by Subko Specialty Coffee Roasters and Craft Bakehouse, the Subko Co-op initiative finds its roots in the village of K. Thadiputtu in Andhra Pradesh. Concentrating its efforts on the holistic advancement of the 'Subko Village,' Subko Co-op has adopted a cluster comprising six tribal farmers from K. Thadiputtu village in Paderu, Andhra Pradesh. With a dedication to bringing these individuals to the forefront of the third wave of coffee, Subko Co-op seeks to not only empower these farmers but to also nurture growth within their entire community.   
   This initiative is focused on tribal farmers who cultivate coffee on government-allotted lands. With an attention on driving direct trade, sustainability, and hyper-traceability, the initiative embodies a commitment to elevating the agricultural landscape in the world of coffee. This endeavor aims to adopt more such clusters in the future. Furthermore, Subko Co-op envisions the establishment of training centers, designed to empower and educate both farmers and their families, paving the way for them to become coffee professionals and authentic representatives of their cultural legacy and heritage. Subko Co-op’s objective is to emerge as a transformative force, reshaping the narrative of coffee cultivation by amalgamating sustainable practices, cultural preservation, and community empowerment, and to narrate origin stories and recognise every stakeholder who puts their heart in coffee cultivation.

Name: Project Seven Sisters: Jampui, Tripura - Lot #249/170 - Medium Omni Roast [White Raisins, Caramel, Cinnamon]
Tasting_Notes: White Raisins, Caramel, Cinnamon
Desc:
Single Origin Coffee from Jampui, Tripura, India 
  Medium Roast  (250g) 
  Process:  Traditional Naturals  
  Agtron Meter:  65 
  Altitude:  800–950     MASL 
    Varietal:   SLN9 
  Cupper's Notes:    White Raisins, Caramel, Cinnamon 
   
 Best Brewed With 
  OMNIROAST   Please note that the best brewed with list is not comprehensive and does not dictate that the coffees cannot be brewed with any other methods. These are the methods we think will extract the best possible cup. However, this coffee can be ground and enjoyed with any brew method that you desire.   About the Process    Traditional Naturals  :     
       Traditional natural process coffee is made by drying freshly harvested, ripe coffee cherries whole, without removing the skin or pulp, allowing the sugars and fruit compounds from the cherry to slowly ferment and infuse into the bean. The cherries are spread on patios or raised beds and regularly turned to ensure even drying and prevent defects, with the process continuing until the coffee reaches a stable moisture level suitable for hulling. This method typically produces coffees with heavier body, enhanced sweetness, and pronounced fruity or wine-like characteristics, reflecting one of the oldest and most heritage-driven approaches to coffee processing.           
     
   
 Cupper's Notes 
 
 
 
 
 
 
   This is a traditional natural process lot, which we roasted medium with a drop temperature of 203   °  C. It bore a prominence across acidity, balance, and sweetness, making it very well-rounded across all parameters. In the cup, we discovered tasting notes of White Raisins, Caramel & Cinnamon.  
   Origin Breakdown   
  Villages that constitute the farmer-collective body we've collaboratively sourced from for Project Seven Sisters, Jampui (Tripura), include: Hmunpui, Tlangsang, Sabual, Behlianchipp, Banglazion, Phuldungsei.  
 
 
 
   
   
 
 
 
 
 
 About Project Seven Sisters 
 
   Project Seven Sisters is a sourcing program that aims to showcase the exceptional coffee growing potential of the Indian Northeast.  
    Despite the challenges posed by its remote location, the initiative seeks to highlight the unique flavors and attributes of the region's coffee, covering the states of Arunachal Pradesh, Nagaland, Manipur, Tripura, and Assam at present.  
    Through this project, we're helping shine a spotlight on the untapped potential of the Indian Northeast, which has long been overshadowed by the dominance of tea production in the region. By supporting the growth of a vibrant and sustainable coffee industry, the project is creating new opportunities for small-scale farmers and building a more diversified agricultural economy in the region.

Desc:
Lumen Blend – Light, Bright & Fruity Coffee

Name: The Saigon Blend
Tasting_Notes: Despite its dark
Desc:
The Saigon Blend 
  It's a Good Morning, Vietnam  
 Inspired by the rich culture, traditions, and flavours of Vietnam, The Saigon Blend is a tribute to the vibrant coffee heritage of this Southeast Asian gem. Crafted from premium Indian Arabica beans, this dark roast is meticulously balanced to offer a harmonious experience of bitterness, sweetness, and acidity. 
  Flavour Profile:  
 
 
 Toasted Nuts:  Warm, inviting, and reminiscent of traditional Vietnamese coffee. 
 
 Cacao:  A deep, rich chocolatey undertone that adds a velvety smoothness to every sip. 
 
  Roast Level:  Dark 
  Perfect For:  Iced manual brew, Vietnamese-style coffee, a hot cappuccino, or an iced black coffee 
  Tasting Notes:  
 
 Despite its dark roast, the flavours remain well-balanced, never overpowering, ensuring an enjoyable cup every time. 
 The nuanced bitterness is complemented by a subtle sweetness, making it versatile for various brewing methods. 
 The complex acidity rounds out the flavour, providing a full-bodied experience that lingers pleasantly on the palate. 
 
 Whether you're craving the boldness of a hot cappuccino or the refreshing chill of an iced brew, The Saigon Blend offers a taste of Vietnam in every cup. Embrace the morning with the rich, satisfying flavours of The Saigon Blend—because every day should start with a touch of Vietnam.

Name: Watermelon ferment - Perfect for Espresso & Cold Brew
Process: Watermelon Fermented (coffee cherries co-fermented with ripe watermelon pulp)
Desc:
Watermelon Fermented   
  Inspired by innovative fermentation techniques , our Watermelon Fermented Coffee is crafted at the Baarbara Estate using only fresh watermelon pulp to highlight the fruit’s bright, juicy character. This medium-roast, 100% Arabica coffee delivers an exhilarating cup that’s as refreshing as it is complex. 
 Flavour Profile 
 
 
 Chocolate Truffles  → Deep, rich cocoa sweetness 
 
 Almonds & Cashews  → Warm, roasted-nut undertones 
 
 Dry Fruits  → Subtle texture of raisin and fig 
 
 Mellow Sweetness  → Silk-like finish that rounds out the cup 
 
  Origin & Process  
 
 
 Location:  Bababudangiri, Chikmagalur 
 
 Process:  Watermelon Fermented (coffee cherries co-fermented with ripe watermelon pulp) 
 
 Altitude:  3,850–5,350 ft 
 
  Roast & Brew  
 
 
 Roast Level:  Medium + roast 
 
 Perfect For:  Espresso, Cold Brew, French Press or Moka Pot  
 
  Allow your beans to  degas for 8–10 days  after roasting to develop and settle the nuanced chocolate-nut flavours. Over time, the cup will reveal layers of truffle-like richness, roasted-nut warmth and a gentle, lingering sweetness. 
   
  
  *No added sugar, honey, fruit, flavour, chicory, or preservatives.  
     Tulum® – Specialty Coffee Roasters

Name: Black Honey (Medium - Dark)
Desc:
This is a coffee for those who enjoy layers in their cup. Balanced fruit and nut flavors shine with both clarity and depth, creating a taste that is rich but never heavy.   
  Process  
   The skin of the coffee cherries are removed using a machine called ‘Pulper’. The beans come covered in pulp, which looks and taste like honey. The beans covered in this gooey pulp is sun-dried, producing a balanced fruit-and-nut cup in high clarity and body.

Name: Carbonic Maceration (Medium)
Desc:
This coffee is for those who want a dependable cup that feels effortless yet never boring. Easy to brew, it rewards you with smooth, layered flavors and a rounded finish that keeps you coming back every day.   
       Process   
  Liquid CO2 from thin, long gas cylinders vaporize into gas as they fill the fermentation chamber brimming with coffee cherries. This process causes a drop in temperature and death of microbes that can’t survive in an atmosphere of CO2, leaving the rest to feast on the rich natural sugars. Produces smooth, complex notes and a rounded finish .

Name: Filter Blend (Dark)
Desc:
This blend of 50% Arabica and 50% Robusta is made for those who find comfort in a homely cup of filter coffee. It’s bold enough to wake you up, yet smooth and mellow enough to feel familiar, like the coffee you grew up with. If you love a cup that feels like home, this one is for you.

 Aroma and flavour from Washed Arabica, and nuttiness from high altitude Robusta. Roasted dark for a strong body and rich, smooth finish. Strictly for milk, and best brewed in a Moka Pot.

Name: Robusta (Dark)
Desc:
This coffee is for those who want strength in their cup. It’s bold, earthy, and packed with caffeine that keeps you awake and keeps you going. Perfect for making Vietnamese iced coffee at home, or whenever you need that extra push.  
       Process   
  The coffee cherries are put through the ‘Pulper’ and ‘Washer’, and the beans are washed clean of all the pulp. The naked bean is sun-dried, eschewing the fruit in its entirety. Produces nutty flavours in exceptional clarity and consistency.
